title: ChatGPT Subscription Provider (Codex OAuth)
description: Add ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription as a provider via OAuth login (Codex flow). New api_type 'codex' using the chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex Responses endpoint, translated to/from the OpenAI chat/completions format. Pattern follows the existing claude-code OAuth provider + anthropic translation client. Design doc: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-chatgpt-codex-provider-design.md
